name: Astro-century Education&Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Founded in 2004 and based in Zibo, China, Astro-century Education&Technology Co.,Ltd focuses on the educational sector. The company primarily develops and sells learning materials for primary, elementary, and high school students across China. Additionally, it provides a suite of online and offline learning and test preparation solutions, marketed under its Zhihong Optimization brand, alongside offering teaching assistance services.
